none: PAS FindID 957608: Roman Coin: Radiate of Postumus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Silver washed radiate of Postumus (260-269), possibly an irregular issue from the reverse, if so, possibly Cunetio 2888:2; Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right, bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP C P[----]VMVS [PF] AVG. Reverse description: stick figure, possibly Victory advancing left holding wreath aloft, long garment with curvilinear pleats. Reverse inscription: possibly [V]ICTOR[IA AVG]. Diameter: 19.8mm, Weight: 2.18gms, die axis: 6
